steps.sql: SET NOCOUNT OFF; CREATE TABLE output_ref(id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,n INT NULL,t NVARCHAR(4) NULL); INSERT INTO output_ref VALUES(10,1,N'one'),(20,2,N'two'); CREATE TABLE output_sink(a INT NOT NULL,b INT NULL)
UPDATE t SET n=t.n+s.extra OUTPUT deleted.*,inserted.*,s.*,deleted.n+s.extra AS computed FROM output_ref t JOIN (VALUES(10,7)) s(id,extra) ON t.id=s.id
SELECT id,n,t FROM output_ref ORDER BY id; SELECT a,b FROM output_sink ORDER BY a,b
